title: Dyson V12 Detect Slim £349.99, LEGO Millennium Falcon £49.98 and Toniebox 2 £87.99
description: Saturday's UK deals: Dyson V12 Detect Slim at a record low, the LEGO Millennium Falcon a third off, Toniebox 2 for £87.99, plus air fryer and gift set cuts.
intro:
**Saturday's big one is the Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute at £349.99 at Argos, down £80 since Thursday and the lowest price PriceSpy has recorded for it.** It matches last Black Friday's best price, so there's little reason to wait. For Christmas toys, the LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon (75375) is £49.98 on Amazon, a third under LEGO's own price, and John Lewis has the Toniebox 2 starter set for £87.99, about £22 below everyone else except Smyths.

In the kitchen, John Lewis has a Philips 9L dual-basket air fryer for £89.99 and the Kenwood kMix stand mixer at its lowest tracked price. Every price below was checked on 14 November. Buy now or wait? The V12, Falcon, Toniebox and kMix are at or near their lows, so they're safe buys. Amazon's kitchen, home and electronics deals start on Monday (16 November), so hold off on Echo, Kindle and Fire TV for now.

deals.name: Dyson V12 Detect Slim Absolute Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Light enough to carry upstairs one-handed, with a laser that shows up dust on hard floors. It was £429.99 on Thursday; £349.99 is PriceSpy's lowest and matches Black Friday 2025. John Lewis is the same price. Compare it with Shark in our new [Shark vs Dyson cordless guide](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon (75375)
deals.note: A 921-piece display model for teen and adult Star Wars fans. PriceSpy's three-month low is £49.49, so this is as good as it gets; John Lewis and Very match it, while LEGO and Argos still charge £75. More in our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: tonies Toniebox 2 Starter Set, Sky Blue
deals.note: A screen-free audio player that 3 to 7-year-olds can work themselves. Boots, Amazon, Argos and Currys are all about £110, so the 'was' price is real; only Smyths matches this.

deals.name: LEGO Fortnite Battle Bus (77073)
deals.note: A 954-piece bus with nine minifigures for Fortnite fans aged 9 and up. LEGO sells it for £89.99; PriceSpy's lowest is about £56, so this is close to the bottom.

deals.name: Hot Wheels 2026 Advent Calendar
deals.note: Die-cast cars and accessories behind each door for car-mad kids. We couldn't find a price history, so take it as 30% off the usual price rather than a record. Other options in our [advent calendars 2026 guide](/guides/advent-calendars-2026-uk/).

deals.name: Philips 3000 Series Dual Basket Air Fryer 9L (NA352/00), Charcoal Grey/Copper
deals.note: Two drawers and 9 litres for under £90, ideal for a family. Ignore the £179.99 'was' price: it has sold for £110 to £154 lately, which still makes this the cheapest we've seen. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Kenwood kMix KMX751ABK Stand Mixer, Black
deals.note: A stylish 5L mixer for keen bakers who don't want to pay KitchenAid prices. It isn't really half price (it's sold for up to about £296 recently), but £180 is the lowest PriceSpy has tracked. Argos is the same. Compare it in our [KitchenAid Black Friday guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone Air Fryer 7.6L (AF300UK)
deals.note: The best-known two-drawer air fryer, and a safe first one to buy. It has been about £6 cheaper before, so it's a good price rather than the lowest ever.

deals.name: Revlon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser (RVDR5222UK4)
deals.note: A cheap way to get a salon-style blow-dry, and an easy gift. It usually sells for £25 to £30, so the 'half price' label is generous, but £25 is near its low. Boots is still £49.99.

deals.name: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum 90ml Gift Set
deals.note: The 90ml perfume plus body lotion, shower gel and a 5ml mini, boxed and ready to wrap. It was 25% off until Thursday and is now 40% off, the biggest cut in John Lewis's fragrance sets. More in our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Amazon's kitchen, home and electronics Black Friday deals start on Monday 16 November, and the main event runs from 19 to 30 November. If you want an Echo, Kindle or Fire TV Stick, wait a couple of days. Our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) has the dates and why you'll want Prime.

Very has added code **EXTRA** for an extra 10% off selected Black Friday products until 18 November; see our updated [Very Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/). And with the V12 at £349.99, our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) now shows which Dyson prices have already hit their targets.

## This week: Christmas toys

Popular toys are holding their price or selling out rather than getting cheaper, so if a toy on your list is at a good price, buy it. Our [Christmas toy deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/) covers what to buy now and what to wait for, and [Hamleys top toys for Christmas 2026](/guides/hamleys-top-toys-christmas-2026/) shows where each top toy is cheapest.
